scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix web && npm install --prefix desktop
scripts.build: npm install --prefix web && npm run build --prefix web
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm install --prefix desktop && npm start --prefix desktop
scripts.expose: concurrently -n app,tunnel -c blue,magenta "npm run serve" ".\cloudflared.exe tunnel --url http://localhost:4000"
scripts.pack:win: npm run build && npm install && electron-builder --win
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix web
